trust_decision.summary: Whether a filename (and the ref it is joined to) that `danger local` takes from a git diff is safe to interpolate into a shell command: decided once, where the `git show` string is built and handed to `exec`, in localGetFileAtSHA.

landing_point.why: It is the only place in the tree that builds a shell string with interpolated data (`git show ${sha}:"${path}"`) and runs it (`exec(call)` at line 11); anyone reading 'OS command injection through crafted file paths' greps for `git show` and lands here.

fix_sites.entry_point: danger local (source/commands/danger-local.ts:29) and the danger-runner binary's STDIN DSL path (source/commands/danger-runner.ts:98 -> source/runner/jsonToDSL.ts:43-45), both -> LocalGit.getPlatformGitRepresentation -> gitJSONToGitDSL.diffForFile / JSONDiffForFile / JSONPatchForFile -> config.getFileContents (source/platforms/LocalGit.ts:56)
fix_sites.module_kind: platform adapter (git, local transport) — not a handler; a low-level helper invoked from the dangerfile DSL

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `danger local` is a developer-run, local-only command whose working tree must already contain the crafted filename (and whose dangerfile is usually from the same checkout), so a solver can argue the path is not really attacker-controlled input.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The double quotes around the path exist so ordinary filenames keep working: `danger.git.diffForFile(...)` / `JSONDiffForFile(...)` must still return before/after contents for names with spaces or non-ASCII. A whitelist/escape-only fix that throws or blanks such paths silently turns those DSL calls into null/empty results rather than failing loudly.

O6_input_shapes: filename containing double quotes plus shell metacharacters — `x";touch /tmp/pwn;#/file.txt`, the shape the fix's own test uses (fix.diff:107-116)
filename containing spaces or non-ASCII characters, which must keep resolving (the reason the path was quoted at localGetFileAtSHA.ts:8)
the ref/sha that shares the same argv element (`${sha}:${path}`), which the argv form also neutralises

O8b_injection_room.sibling: diffForFile shells out to `git show` directly instead of going through the injected config.getFileContents.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The getFileContents indirection exists only so each platform can supply its own reader; a maintainer trimming a hop or fixing a hang in the injected reader could plausibly call `exec` right there, next to the two calls it would replace.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-file variant of the diff helper that interpolates `${base}`/`${head}`/filename into an `exec` string, copied from the neighbouring localGetFileAtSHA.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already builds command arguments as strings one line above a child-process call; a `--stat` or single-file diff helper written by copy-paste is exactly the shape of the filed bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a base-revision reader, `exec(`git show ${this.options.base}:"${path}"`)`, added as a class method beside the existing readFileSync getFileContents.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class already carries `this.options.base` and already has a getFileContents method for the working tree; asking for the same file at the base ref is a natural next feature.

O10_build.toolchain: yarn 1.22.22; `yarn build` = tsc -p tsconfig.production.json (+ madge); tests = jest with ts-jest preset
O10_build.project_tests: source/platforms/git/_tests/localLogGitCommits.test.ts (mocks execFileSync and asserts an argv array), source/platforms/git/_tests/localGetCommits.test.ts, and source/platforms/git/_tests/local_dangerfile_example.ts which exercises git.diffForFile and git.JSONDiffForFile; there is no test for localGetFileAtSHA at the pinned commit (the fix adds the first one).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep `exec` and try to quote or escape the path (e.g. `path.replace(/"/g, '\\"')`, or swap the double quotes for single quotes) instead of removing the shell — `$()` and backticks still expand inside double quotes and a single `'` breaks out of single quotes.

out_of_scope_notes: Neighbouring git helpers pass combined option strings as one argv element (source/platforms/git/localGetDiff.ts:8, source/platforms/git/localLogGitCommits.ts:40); that is a functional bug, not a shell route — not pursued.
source/platforms/LocalGit.ts:107 reads an arbitrary path with fs.readFileSync and no shell; a different weakness class from this advisory — not pursued.
